title: goals v4: the kick-off formation rule plus a ball at the centre spot
written: 2026-11-09, before any ball detection at the centre spot; hashed (plan.json.sha256) before the first probe
owner request: 2026-11-09: 'Oui, prépare le plan du ballon au point central' (after goals_v3 failed its bar and the false-run reading)
why: goals_v3 (registered): held out 34/41 restartable goals, 8.5 false runs per match, team 0.79. reading_false_runs*.json (exploratory): the false runs fall in live play (labelled actions 1-2 s around), a goal is followed by >= 15 s of dead ball and a kick-off with the ball still on the centre spot; 1-fps people positions do not give a dead-ball cue. Here: is a ball on the centre spot that cue?
data: the 20 halves of the 10 SoccerTrack v2 matches (M7 128057 and M9 132831 are development data since 2026-11-05; each opening goes through src/unseal.py with the reason 'development use, seal lifted 2026-11-05'); the 1-fps people scans of goals_v3 (.cache/formation_scan/, unchanged); BAS events for goals and actions; the half videos streamed from Hugging Face (st.open_video, st.read_frames). The truth has no ball, so the cue is judged only through the goals it keeps and the false runs it removes.

changes from goals_v3 fixed now (both mo.defended ends: the team with the lower mean x over the half's first 10 s (frames 0-250, team-labelled scan people) defends x < 0 (right on 20/20 halves in reading_false_runs_extra.json; the videos start at the kick-off: the first labelled action is at 0-2 s on all 20 halves)
changes from goals_v3 fixed now (both mo.matching window: a run matches a GOAL if it starts 10-60 s after it (was 15-60 s; 3 goals_v3 misses started 11-14 s after their goal). Restartable goals stay as goals_v3 (a later action >= 15 s after the goal).

ball detector arms.region: the centre spot (0, 0) and a box of +-12 m (x) by +-8 m (y) around it, projected to pixels through the match's camera (formation_scan.camera: M1 the refit, others the release), padded by 32 px; a detection's pitch position is its box's bottom centre (Y arms) or its ground point (H arm) through st.image_to_pitch
ball detector arms.Y1, Y2, Y3: yolov8s (crop_check.MODEL, the pipeline's weights), COCO sports ball (crop_check.BALL_CLASS_ID) only, on the region crop upscaled x1, x2, x3 (imgsz = crop width x scale, rounded up to 32), conf floor 0.02
ball detector arms.H: ball_v3b.1500.pt through ball_heatmap.detect_v2 with its calibration (p_cal), motion from frames t-2 / t+2 and a background from motion_bg's samples (every 50th frame, +-15 s, within what was decoded), the region as the outline, tau 0.02, top_k 8. Note: v3b was trained on 3-min windows of 7 of the 10 matches (provenance), never on M1, M7, M9; per-match results are reported.

stage 1: probe (choose one arm; decides.kick-off frames: on each of the 20 halves, frames 0, 5, 10, ... up to the half's first labelled action f0 (at least frame 0): the ball is on the centre spot until the kick
stage 1: probe (choose one arm; decides.live-play samples: per half, 10 windows of 5 consecutive 1-s samples (frames multiple of 25) starting at 40, 70, ..., 310 s; a window is kept if it has >= 1 labelled action and no GOAL in the 90 s before it
kick-off recall: share of halves with a ball >= c within 2 m of the spot on >= 1 kick-off frame; live rate: share of live-play samples with a ball >= c within 2 m of the spot
stage 1: probe (choose one arm; decides.choice: per arm, c* = the smallest c with live rate <= 0.03; the arm with the highest kick-off recall at its c*, ties: lower live rate, then the cheaper arm (Y1, Y2, Y3, H)
stage 1: probe (choose one arm; decides.go: the chosen arm's kick-off recall >= 0.75 (15 of 20 halves). Otherwise stop: no stage 2, report the probe.

stage 2: the chosen arm on the candidate.spans: for every cell of the grid below, the formation runs of each half (kick-off ends, goals_v3's runs: 60-s start exclusion, 20-s merge), each extended to its end + 10 s; the union of these, on every 1-s sample (frames multiple of 25). The grid's loosest cell (T 0.75, no R, N 1) gave ~8,800 s over the 20 halves in a count made while writing this plan.
stage 2: the chosen arm on the candidate.rows: per sample, the chosen arm's ball detections in the region at conf >= its floor (frame, conf, u, v, x, y) -> .cache/ball_spot/<match>_<half>.parquet, written in resumable chunks
stage 2: the chosen arm on the candidate.throughput: the probe's measured seconds per sample sets the estimate before stage 2 starts; local CPU only, two lanes

rule.formation run: goals_v3's: >= N consecutive 1-s samples with own-half share >= T (and, when R is set, the nearest team-labelled person within R m of the spot), 60-s start exclusion, 20-s merge; kick-off ends
rule.ball cue: a run is kept if, among the samples from its start to its end + 10 s, >= K samples have a ball detection >= c within D m of the spot
rule.alarm: a kept run; matched to GOALs as goals_v3 with the 10-60 s window; hits on restartable goals; a kept run matched to no goal is a false run
rule.scoring team (kick_ball, primary): at the cue's last sample with a ball >= c within D m, the team of the team-labelled scan person nearest that ball kicks off, so the other team scored
rule.scoring team (kick_spot, reported): goals_v3's: the person nearest the spot at the run's last sample

grid.c: the probe's c grid from the chosen c* upward: c in {0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5} with c >= c*

choice of the cell: most hits on restartable goals, then fewest false runs, then larger T, smaller R (None last), larger c, smaller D, larger K, smaller N
held out: leave one match out: the cell chosen on 9 matches' halves, scored on the 10th's; pooled over the 10 matches
bar (unchanged from goals_v3, the owner': restartable goals found >= 0.95 and <= 1 false run per match, held out; scoring team right (kick_ball) on >= 0.9 of hits
also reported: the same held out without the ball cue (kick-off ends and the 10-60 s window only), to separate the effects
per match: hits, restartable goals, false runs, team right, chosen cell
the cell chosen on all 10 matches
random-time baseline as goals_v3 (same run counts per half, 1000 draws, seed 0)
kick-off frames of the restartable goals (the first labelled action >= 10 s after each goal): share with a ball >= c within D m in the 10 s before it, at the cells chosen (exploratory)
cost: local CPU only, no GPU, no Kaggle. Probe: ~20 x (frames up to f0, ~11 each) + 1,000 live samples, under an hour. Stage 2: ~8,800 samples (~2.5 h of video) decoded in spans, estimated 2-5 h on two lanes. Disk: tens of MB.
what this cannot show: the bar is the owner's; these 20 halves have been looked at (goals_v3 and its readings), so a pass here is development evidence and the owner's own matches remain the test
